name: Short Cut Chicken Fettuccine Alfredo with Sun-Dried Tomatoes, Broccoli & Lemon

instructions.primary_message: Spread noodles over the bottom of a large skillet. Shake sauce package to combine, then add to the skillet along with 1/2-cup water. Set skillet over medium-high heat and cook, stirring gently and frequently, for 6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 (1106 g) pkg chicken fettuccine Alfredo meal kit

instructions.primary_message: While the pasta is heating, slice sun-dried tomatoes into thin strips. Add tomatoes and chicken to the skillet; continue to cook, stirring often, until heated through, 3-4 minutes more. Remove from heat.

Meanwhile, place broccoli bag on a microwave safe plate and pierce with a fork. Place in the microwave and cook on high, until tender, 4-5 minutes. Remove plate from microwave and carefully open the bag to let out the steam.
While the broccoli is cooking, wash, dry, and cut lemon into wedges.
To serve, divide chicken fettuccine and broccoli between plates. Juice lemon over top, then season to taste with salt and pepper. Enjoy!
